intro: Master Vornal of Sen'jin Village tests fledgling adventurers by demanding reagents to compensate for his failing eyesight. He sends prospective pupils to harvest makrura eyes and crawler mucus along the coast of Durotar. While he scoffs at the idea of taking an apprentice, the task serves as a deliberate trial of patience and resolve.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.
Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... Of course you think you are.
I need a few things. Will you get them for me?
I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, young one... Well done indeed.
